title: Case Studies — Tom Schoorstra
description: Explore my HubSpot and RevOps work in CRM architecture, data quality monitoring, finance automation and custom record interfaces.
paragraphs: How I approach CRM architecture, data quality, integrations and record interfaces, with the decisions and limits that matter in practice.
I connected AIHR's customer records through a custom Account object in HubSpot, with workflows and weekly checks to keep the data linked.
September 2026 project snapshot: the core setup is live; enrichment remains in progress.
At AIHR, I built a detection layer that compares HubSpot with learning-platform data through Snowflake, bringing missing links and conflicting statuses into one data quality dashboard.
August 2026 project snapshot: datasets and dashboard are in place; member-count validation and source freshness still need follow-up.
I connected HubSpot, WooCommerce and Exact through Zapier so order details pass between systems after Finance reviews the billing information.
I built a HubSpot sidebar card that reads the linked License and shows the renewal status on the deal, so reps can check it where they're already working.
I consolidated several HubSpot pipelines into one, making it easier to measure conversion from MQL to Closed Won and manage internal handovers.
Questions about the work? Get in touch.
